name: openSUSE
description: openSUSE Leap 16.0, Leap 16.1, or Tumbleweed as official cloud-image VMs with Cloud-Init.

notes.text: Select Leap 16.0 (default), Leap 16.1, or Tumbleweed. For unattended deployment, set VM_OS_VERSION=16.0, 16.1, or tumbleweed.
Cloud-Init is required for the initial account, credentials, and networking. The cloud image defaults to the opensuse username.
Image SHA-256 verification protects downloads and checks cached rolling-release images for updates.
